Notes: -
1. During the quarter ended 30th September, 2026, the company has achieved an EBITDA of Rs. 42.33 Crores and earned a Standalone Net Profit of Rs. 31.03 Crores as compared to the EBITDA of Rs. 8.55 Crores and Standalone Net Profit of Rs. 8.76 Crores during the corresponding quarter of previous financial year.

The above results have been subjected to limited review by the statutory auditors of the Company. The reports of the statutory auditors are unqualified.

3. The Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended 30.09.2026 have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards (Ind-AS) as prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 and other accounting principles generally accepted in India and in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015.
